question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Study of insects
solution: The correct answer is '**Entomology**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Entomology**'. • **Entomology**: the scientific study of insects. (कीटविज्ञान) • *Example: He decided to specialize in **entomology** after graduation.* **Correct Answer:__** *Entomology.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Geology**: the study of rocks, and of the way they are formed. (चट्टानों और उनके निर्माण-प्रकार का अध्‍ययन; भूविज्ञान) • **Ecology**: the relationship between living things and their surroundings; the study of this subject. (सजीवों का अपने परिवेश से संबंध; पर्यावरण का अध्ययन; पर्यावरण-विज्ञान) • **Biology**: the scientific study of living things. (सजीवों का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन; जैविकी, जीवविज्ञान) 40:T935, The correct answer is** 'haven't you?'.**
